income_definition.definition: Individual October 25, 2024 PEIMS economic status uses each school’s own CPNTECOC economically disadvantaged count divided by its own CPNTALLC enrollment denominator covering all enrolled EE–12. CPETALLC membership is a separate administrative measure and never supplies that denominator. State codes 01/02/99 include free/reduced meal eligibility or other public assistance; CPNTECOC plus CPNTNEDC and native tenth-percent CPNTECOP display reconcile. This broader state-specific proxy differs from uniform FRPL, household income and the tested accountability subset. details: Northside ISD independent2024–25 original published-rate grade-school models use exact CCD LEA4833120/TX-015915/TAPR015915. All107 positive native enrolled grades3–8/explicit-zero grades9–12 profiles remain searchable; three alternative-campus Math/ELA masks leave104 observations in each separate Math, ELA and own Combined model. These concepts remain distinct, without assigning a verified individual cause or substituting assessment denominators.

Native published whole-percent rates differ from unverified count ratios in103 of104 eligible schools for each subject; count-ratio precision is not selected. Alternative SECOND CHANCE ACADEMY015915061, ALTERNATIVE MIDDLE015915062 and ALTERNATIVE EL015915172 retain positive lower-grade enrollment and own income but no published Math/ELA rates; their observations and history gaps stay missing. HOMEBOUND015915133/NCES483312005564 has no native enrollment/income/outcome table and remains outside with source evidence.

All valid-score counts, sampling variances and interval endpoints are null; sampling intervals unavailable. Exact2025 N/NAAR/M status remains held and numerical success does not certify valid scores or the ten-scored minimum.

Full and every deleted design have rank two and finite positive residual scales. All income extremes and influential schools remain eligible. HELOTES EL483312003700 has the highest Cook distance in all three models and remains included. Unbounded OLS predictions, leverage/Cook/residual flags remain descriptive; no clamping or exclusions.

Compact references require all six complete source/numerical audit/code/test blobs and current source/model/literal runtime/policy/fingerprints on each replay before any SQL. Historical approvals remain false; only this separately validated normalized lower-grade point contract is released.
